svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.21.7 Smoke Detectors
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION

g.text: Smoke detectors in the corridor serving
the sleeping rooms, connected to the
16 sleeping rooms with 1 bed each: sleeping accommodation for 16 persons, more than 10, so the Article applies.
Smoke detector positions drawn are examples.

svg.text: Corridors providing access to exit from
sleeping rooms in construction camp buildings
with sleeping accommodation for more than 10
persons are provided with a smoke detector
connected to the building alarm system
Drawn: a sleeping quarters plan with walls cut low. Red dashed: wiring to the alarm system.
